uda: UDA is the major Protestant paramilitary group in Northern Ireland.
UDA means the same as Ulster Defence Association.
udder: Udder is mammary gland of bovids.
Udder means the same as bag.
udmurt: Udmurt is a member of the Finno-Ugric-speaking people living in eastern European Russia.
Udmurt can also mean the Finnic language spoken by the Votyak.
Udmurt means the same as Votyak.
udometer: Udometer is gauge consisting of an instrument to measure the quantity of precipitation.
Udometer means the same as rain gauge or rain gage or pluviometer.
